summary: Four-player partnership trick-taking game with hearts as permanent trumps where players bid tricks individually.
rules_text: Four players in fixed partnerships (N-S vs E-W) use a 52-card deck, hearts permanent trump. Dealer deals 13 cards each anticlockwise. Starting right of dealer, each player bids once the number of tricks they will take (>=1). If sum of bids <=10 hand is thrown in and redealt. Otherwise play 13 tricks: leader plays any card, others must follow suit of lead if able, else may trump or discard. Highest trump wins, else highest of led suit. Winner leads next. Scoring is individual: bidding 1-6 scores +bid if made, -bid if failed. Bidding 7+ scores double: +2*bid if made, -2*bid if failed, extra tricks give nothing. Partnership wins when one partner reaches >=41 points while other partner has >0 points; if both teams qualify same deal, higher combined total wins.
